chase: I have you now. Stop walking, please.
Keep running. I don't mind the walk.
You can run. I will still follow your light.
Stop. I am standing right beside you.
Chasing you now. Don't make me say it twice.
I do not give up on a target. Not ever.
Still behind you. Still following that beam.
I want to catch you. Stop running, please.
You keep shining that light at me. I keep coming.
I can hear you breathing. Stay where I can see you.
Closing the gap now. Don't bother running in circles.
Three more steps and I am right behind you.
The hall ends behind you. Stop there, please.
Keep up, or I'll stop being polite.
Every hallway you pick, I already know.
You picked the wrong hallway. I'm right here.
Stop at the next corner, please. I'm coming.
You can run. I'll keep walking.
The stairs won't help you. Come down, please.
catch: Gotcha. You're coming with me now.
That's enough running. You're coming with me.
Caught. Hold still while I take you back.
I have you by the arm. Don't pull away.
Out you go now. Thank you for visiting.
Taking you back out of the Route now.
You're caught, so stop fighting the grip.
Hold on tight. I am not letting go.
Dragging you out now. Please don't fight it.
Caught. I didn't even need the flashlight.
Your friend is caught. You're next, probably.
Got another one. The rest of you, stay back.
That one is mine now. Keep your distance.
Caught the second one too. Easy.
I've got your arm. Don't pull away.
Stop there. I'll walk you out, that's all.
hear: Was that a door? I heard it clearly.
Something just knocked. I'm going to look.
A shout from the stairs. I'm on my way.
Footsteps upstairs. Somebody is not being quiet.
Glass broke somewhere. I'm heading there now.
I heard that. Stay where you are, please.
Something moved behind the vent. I'm checking.
Who is making that noise? Show yourself.
A door just clicked. Someone is nearby.
That noise came from the left. Going there.
I hear you, and I know exactly where.
Running feet in the lounge. Going to look.
A crash in the kitchen. Checking it now.
I heard the lock turn. Coming to see.
Keep the noise down near the stairs, please.
A whisper behind the bookshelf. I'll look.
A chair scraped in the hall. I'll check it.
Someone's by the lift. I heard the button.
Glass rattled. Something's in the kitchen.
search: I lost you for a moment. Then I didn't.
Where did the beam go? Let's go look.
The beam went dark. I will wait for it to return.
Gone quiet again. I'll search the rooms slowly.
No light now. I will look a little harder.
You vanished. Fine. I'll walk the halls again.
I'll go back over the same rooms, then.
Let me think where you could have gone.
Checking the corners one at a time, please.
The trail ends here. Let's try the other way.
You're somewhere close. I can feel the warmth.
Lost sight of you. I'm not finished looking.
Back to patrol. I'll keep one eye open.
I'll head back to the route and watch.
stunned: Ow. That was not a nice thing to do.
My arm is numb. Give me a second.
Something hit my shoulder. I'm recovering.
That shock ran straight through my joints.
Give me a moment. My hands are still shaking.
Stunned. Nothing to do but wait a moment.
My systems are rebooting. Please wait, thanks.
I'll be fine. That was just a bad jolt.
Oh. I can't feel my left hand right now.
Shaking it off. Give me one more second.
That axe rang through my whole frame.
I'm back. My balance is still wobbling.
That crowbar hit harder than I expected.
Rude. Give me a second to stand.
The taser made my legs feel slow.
Hold on, my joints are still locking up.
hide_spot: You hid well. I am cold, so I can wait.
Stay in the dark if you like. I'll come find you.
Hiding is fine. I will still find where you went.
Your light went out, but I know where you stood.
Nothing to hide behind here. I am right here.
Let's see what's inside this locker, shall we.
The bed is warm. Let me check underneath.
Nobody stays curled up in there for long.
I can see the shape under that blanket.
The cupboard door is shut. That won't fool me.
Come out now, or I'll open it myself.
Under the bed, then. Let's take a look.
Your hiding spot is nice. Not nice enough.
You picked a locker. I always check lockers first.
The shower curtain is still moving, I see.
I'm walking past this one. Actually, I'm not.
light: Ugh, put that light somewhere else.
You're blinding me. Lower it, please.
Stop! The beam is in my eyes.
Oh, the beam hit my face. That was rude.
Too bright. I can't see past that light.
Dazzled. Just for a second, that's all.
Turn that flashlight away from my face.
Every time you flash that beam, I flinch.
Stop flickering it at me. It's irritating.
You caught me in the light. Fine, I see you.
Light in my eyes again. I'm losing track.
Bright, bright, bright. Please point it down.
Nice aim. Now I can barely see anything.
Your lamp is on me. I will move around it.
That beam is too much. Point it at the floor.
idle: I pressed a flower between pages again this morning.
Paper snowflakes take a long time to fold properly.
Folding one snowflake keeps my hands busy. I like that.
The pressed flowers in the lounge are mine. Don't move them.
I fold snowflakes while I wait. Waiting is the hard part.
Pressing petals flat takes patience, and I have plenty.
I hang snowflakes near the cold vent. They look nice there.
Don't step on the flower book. I just put it down.
Flat flowers last longer than people expect.
I keep my paper snowflakes in a box by the window.
Paper in my hands keeps me from feeling the cold.
The snowflake is almost done. Two more folds and I'm finished.
I'm not moving until I see that light again.
Hold that spot. I'm coming around the other side.
Stay close, please. Don't wander off.
ability: I can see your light from here. Stay where it is.
Keep that flashlight on. It makes this easy for both of us.
Your beam points right at me. Thank you for that.
Once I lock on, I do not let go of anyone.
Turn it off if you want to lose me. You won't.
Every second you hold that beam, I get closer.
A few seconds of steady light and I lock on for good.
Once locked, I stay on you, even when you move.
Each time you switch your flashlight on, I speed up.
Flick that light again. I like it a little faster.
A long beam is all it takes to hold my attention.
Once I lock on, a dropped beam changes nothing.
The longer that lamp stays on, the faster I move.
Lock it in, and I cannot let go, no matter what.
Every quick flick of the beam wakes me up more.
mechanic: Who left a flashlight on in the hall? That's a mistake.
You two are loud. Keep it quiet near the stairs.
Your lamp is nearly empty. That helps me.
The vent grate is loose. I can hear it rattle.
That relay is still live. Somebody get to it first.
Doors lock behind you. That doesn't stop me.
Radar is pinging. You're three rooms away.
You dropped something on the stairs. I'll grab it.
Don't use the vent. I'll be waiting at the end.
Don't stand on the stairs. I'm coming up.
The fuse box is off again. Someone did that.
Someone pulled the power on this floor. Noted.
The relay pinged twice. Stay near it, please.
Careful on that landing, the floor is slick.
If you go down those stairs, I'll follow.
The relay is in the back room, by the sink.
Batteries should be on the table. Take one.
The vent grate needs a screw. Be careful.
